svg.text: Spin errors over one hour of free flight, zero external wrench
ESTIMATE vehicle: mass 12000 kg, inertia diag(28000, 55000, 55000) kg m^2. Not a published Dragon value.
Initial angular velocity w0 = (0.15, 0.25, -0.10) rad/s. dt = 0.005 s. 720,000 ticks = 3600 s = 1 hour. 1,201 samples, one every 600 ticks.
Relative errors below 1e-18 are clamped to the floor 1e-18 (zeros clamped) before log10. Dashed line = floor.
Relative kinetic energy error |E(t) - E0| / E0
Relative inertial angular momentum error ||L(t) - L0|| / ||L0||
Summary: raw relative errors (not clamped), max and final over 1,201 samples
